contradictions_resolved.conflict: A historical identifier may appear absent in available search while repository history coverage is incomplete.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Absence remains unresolved_incomplete_coverage until CM-1031 accepts an exhaustive envelope.

falsification_route: The slice is falsified if authenticated execution misses an accessible branch, fails to reach a reachable root despite complete provider traversal, accepts an incomplete artifact-search record, overwrites an existing output, or produces an envelope rejected by the unchanged CM-1031 validator for a collector-caused schema defect.
